step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a data ingestion and BI analytics pipeline. Front-end client dashboards connect via ELB to an EKS cluster running worker nodes on EC2. Data is ingested from various sources (External DB, Athena, Glue, S3, RDS, and source Redshift) into EC2 workers. Hot, low-latency data is stored in FSx for Lustre (backed up to S3), while warm/large-scale data is routed to a target Redshift warehouse.
